mapper.select: SELECT id,grant_epoch,source_epoch,deletion_epoch FROM ai_memory_source WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND source_type='KNOWLEDGE_DOCUMENT' AND LEFT(source_object_ref,OCTET_LENGTH(#{base})+1)=CONCAT(#{base},_binary':') AND deletion_epoch=0 ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_memory_source SET grant_epoch=grant_epoch+1,source_epoch=source_epoch+1,deletion_epoch=deletion_epoch+1,retention_deadline=LEAST(retention_deadline,UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} AND source_type='KNOWLEDGE_DOCUMENT' AND deletion_epoch=0
mapper.select: SELECT o.tenant_id,o.event_id,o.aggregate_id AS source_id,o.deletion_epoch AS epoch,o.attempts FROM ai_memory_outbox o JOIN ai_memory_source s ON s.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND s.id=o.aggregate_id WHERE o.event_type='KNOWLEDGE_SOURCE_REVOKED' AND o.status IN ('QUEUED','BLOCKED','CLAIMED') AND o.attempts<8 AND s.retention_deadline>DATE_SUB(UTC_TIMESTAMP(6),INTERVAL 24 HOUR) AND (o.lease_until IS NULL OR o.lease_until<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) ORDER BY o.event_id LIMIT 16
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_memory_outbox SET status='CLAIMED',attempts=attempts+1,revision=revision+1,receipt_ref=#{token},lease_until=DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(6),INTERVAL 60 SECOND) WHERE tenant_id=#{row.tenantId} AND event_id=#{row.eventId} AND attempts=#{row.attempts} AND status IN ('QUEUED','BLOCKED','CLAIMED') AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))
UPDATE ai_memory_outbox SET status='SUCCEEDED''BLOCKED',revision=revision+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{row.tenantId} AND event_id=#{row.eventId} AND receipt_ref=#{token} AND status='CLAIMED'
